mapper.insert: insert into userinfo(name, num, pwd, userimageurl,type) values (#{name}, #{num}, #{pwd}, #{userImageUrl},#{type})
mapper.select: select t1.id, t1.photo_url as photoUrl, t1.tag_id as tagId, t1.dateTime, t1.user_id as userId, t1.file_path as filePath, t1.fingerprint, t1.title from photoinfo t1 left join userinfo t2 on t1.user_id = t2.id where t2.id = #{userId,jdbcType=INTEGER}

select t1.id, t1.photo_url as photoUrl, t1.tag_id as tagId, t1.dateTime, t1.user_id as userId, t1.file_path as filePath, t1.fingerprint, t1.title from photoinfo t1, userinfo t2, usercollection t3 where t1.id = t3.photo_id and t2.id = t3.user_id and t3.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=INTEGER}

and `name` like CONCAT('%',#{userName},'%')
